scope.name: Golden Cross-Topology Garment Proof
in_scope: deterministic end-to-end garment proof across ordinary and difficult CAS-GOLDEN-1 topology profiles
FGA-PARAM-1 garment semantics through FGA-02 topology fit, anchor, clearance, mask and occlusion handling
FGA-03 reusable primitive and explicit coverage-demand behavior across required garment views
FGA-04 Fashion Design Studio edit, preview, save and CAS-WARD-001 proposal behavior under topology variation
FGA-05 clothing-reference proposal review path with explicit uncertainty and no hidden-detail invention
provider-off deterministic reproduction and fail-closed unsupported coverage
out_of_scope: new garment semantics or a second fashion authority
generative image synthesis or a new renderer
PAPT asset generation or paid production execution
